case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS.598-600 OF 2013; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.337 OF 2014; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS.745-748 OF 2015
summary: Murder of four family members with sharp-edged weapons; prosecution based on injured eyewitness Smt Pinky (PW-1); confessional statements leading to recovery of blood-stained weapons; death penalty commuted by High Court to life imprisonment; State appealed for enhancement to death sentence; accused Ajai abated due to death; reliance on eyewitness testimony and forensic recovery confirmed; motive rooted in familial and neighborhood enmity over alcohol consumption.
final_judgment: Appeals of accused partially abated; High Court's commutation of death penalty to life imprisonment upheld; State's appeal for enhancement of sentence dismissed.
